themes.description: Users report that Zerodha’s customer support is largely unavailable or ineffective across all channels, leading to unresolved complaints, delayed fund transfers, and frustration when urgent issues arise.
themes.business_impact: The lack of timely and reliable support is causing immediate financial loss (e.g., missed trades, uncredited deposits), driving negative word‑of‑mouth that threatens to increase churn, reduce new sign‑ups, and ultimately erode revenue growth.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: Zerodha’s support infrastructure relies on a single, under‑staffed phone line with no redundant or alternative channels, coupled with a fragmented ticketing system that lacks clear SLAs and knowledge management, resulting in repeated failure to resolve issues.
themes.action_plan:
• Audit existing support processes and staffing levels
• Expand support channels to include email, WhatsApp, in‑app chat, and 24/7 phone line
• Define and enforce SLA targets for first response and resolution
• Deploy a unified ticketing system with tagging and escalation rules
• Build a searchable knowledge base and FAQ to reduce ticket volume
• Monitor support KPIs and collect customer feedback post‑resolution
